opening.argument: The speaker presents a $10 payment as the way to join Forsage and activate X3 and X4 slots, then connects participation with earnings transferred to a cryptocurrency wallet. The dashboard reinforces that solicitation: it shows a personal Forsage link with sharing controls, a displayed 25 BUSD profit, and an invitation to join. It also displays an X3 entry requiring 15 BUSD alongside Partners and Team panels, while offering a 10 BUSD activation for the Ambassador Program. Together, these details present tiered slots, personal earnings, and team activity as reasons to participate, rather than offering a neutral explanation of the platform.
